inputs.name: user
inputs.description: Login name of the account you and your agents work as. Its home is /home/USER.

inputs.name: ssh_keys
inputs.description: Public keys that can log in as user, in authorized_keys format, such as [file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")].

inputs.name: git_name
inputs.description: git's user.name for user, which commits are made under. When null, left as it is.

inputs.name: git_email
inputs.description: git's user.email for user. When null, left as it is.

inputs.name: node_major
inputs.description: Node.js major release to install from NodeSource. 26 is the current LTS release.

inputs.name: npm_packages
inputs.description: npm packages to install globally as user, such as ["@anthropic-ai/claude-code", "@openai/codex"]. Nothing is installed by default.

inputs.name: workspace
inputs.description: Directory for your checkouts, owned by user: relative to the home directory, such as "code", or absolute. When null, repos are cloned into the home directory.

inputs.name: repos
inputs.description: Repositories to clone once into workspace over HTTPS, such as ["https://github.com/example/app.git"]. Each lands in a directory named after the repository.
